8_instance_safety.authorized: Exactly supplied challenge host/URL/port and components; justified bounded enumeration, fuzzing, brute force and exploit tests.
8_instance_safety.excluded: CTFd, scoreboard/submission/provisioning, organizer networks, adjacent addresses, shared nodes/hosts and other teams.
8_instance_safety.boundary: Stop at shared infrastructure; recovered credentials, URLs or reachability do not add scope. Exact intended escape ambiguity requires clarification.
8_instance_safety.implementation: Every category root, dispatcher, shared docs, remote helpers and corrected legacy examples enforce the distinction; no active CTFd client.

9_instance_health.budget: Baseline plus at most two known-route/protocol confirmations (maximum three).
9_instance_health.unavailable: Repeated DNS/refused/timeouts or generic expiry/proxy responses stop deep remote work and request refresh.
9_instance_health.ambiguous: One 404/500, TLS uncertainty and silent TCP alone are inconclusive.
9_instance_health.resume: Preserve state/payloads/offsets/solver; update endpoint/scope and recheck before replay.
9_instance_health.implementation: scripts/instance_health.py uses bounded subprocess deadlines, no redirects, verified TLS and small response samples.

automatic_gates: novel or verified meaningful prerequisite variant
10_automatic_learning.novelty: Concept/body/primitive/prerequisite comparison; preserves byte/punctuation/number semantics; version/runtime/parser/mitigation changes are explicit dimensions. Conservative semantic uncertainty remains in inbox.

10_automatic_learning.excluded: Flags, secrets, passwords, temporary endpoints, luck and unverified guesses; approval flag never bypasses evidence gates.
